== Summary ==
Identified: [[Tamás Papp]] (grey shirt, denim shorts, white watch, setting up a recording rig; same clothing as [[:File:2023 Naboo Regionals 10.jpg]]). A man with glasses in a black tee and cargo shorts, and the man in the pink shirt, are not named.

Setting up game recording equipment at the 2023 Naboo Regionals ("Foil Fest") weekend in Liverpool, UK, 1 June 2023, hosted by Team Wales.

* '''Event:''' [[2023 Regional Championships]]
* '''Date:''' 1 June 2023
* '''Date posted:''' 2023-05-31
* '''Identification:''' [[Tamás Papp]] (grey shirt, denim shorts, white watch, setting up a recording rig; same clothing as [[:File:2023 Naboo Regionals 10.jpg]]). A man with glasses in a black tee and cargo shorts, and the man in the pink shirt, are not named.
